fact: On 1 March 2024 the national business climate committee visited Malabo port to review problems of the SIDUNEA customs system, which processes manifests and declarations.
title: El Comité Nacional del Clima de Negocios visita la Ventanilla Única Empresarial y el Puerto de Malabo
publisher: Gobierno de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial (guineaecuatorialpress.com)
